description: This file provides a retry wrapper module for Python functions, including a custom exception class, utility functions for retry logic, and a decorator for retrying functions on exceptions. It is intended to substitute for external retry packages due to dependency constraints.

classes.name: RetriesExceeded
classes.description: Custom exception class that records retry failure conditions, including number of retries and the function that was retried.

methods.name: _retry_function
methods.description: Internal function that performs the retry logic, calling the provided function and handling exceptions with optional backoff and exception wrapping.

methods.name: with_retry
methods.description: Function that calls a given function with retry logic, allowing positional and keyword arguments, exception types, retries, backoff, and exception wrapping options.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Decorator that applies retry logic to a function, retrying on specified exceptions with configurable retries, backoff, and exception wrapping.
